entities.summary: The Chitose Line is a railway line in Hokkaido operated by Hokkaido Railway Company, connecting Numanohata, Tomakomai and Shiroishi Station in Shiroishi-ku, Sapporo, linking the Muroran Main Line and Hakodate Main Line. There also is a branch line to New Chitose Airport. Chitose Line is a railway line from Asia. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
